component.name: Disk Space
component.summary: Find what is filling your disk

description.p: Disk Space scans a folder or a whole drive and shows where the space went, while it is still looking. Every file is drawn in proportion to its size and coloured by kind, so a directory that has quietly filled up is visible rather than merely findable.

It also answers a question most disk usage tools do not: not what is big, but what is new. Every folder carries four figures rather than one, so the whole disk can be ranked by what arrived in the last month rather than by what has always been there.

ul.li: Hard links are counted once, not once per name
Sparse and compressed files report what they occupy, not what they claim
Symbolic links are recorded and never followed out of the tree
Mount points are left to be scanned in their own right
Totals agree with du to the byte
